title: Part 1 · 家乡 Hometown
prompts: Is it a big city or a small town?
What do you like most about it?
Has it changed much since you were a child?
sampleAnswer: My hometown is a medium-sized coastal city in the south. I love the seafood and the relaxed pace of life. Compared with my childhood, it has grown a lot, with new malls and a subway line.
explanation: Part 1 考察日常交流，回答简洁自然、适当扩展即可。

title: Part 1 · 住所 Accommodation
prompts: Do you live in a house or a flat?
What do you like about where you live?
sampleAnswer: I live in a flat on the tenth floor with my family. I like the view and the安静. I share it with my parents and my younger brother. I'd love to move to a bigger place one day.
explanation: 用具体细节（楼层、家人）让回答更真实。

title: Part 1 · 工作/学习 Work or Study
prompts: What subject do you study / what is your job?
What is a typical day like?
sampleAnswer: I'm a university student majoring in economics. I enjoy it because the topics are relevant to real life, though some maths courses are tough. A typical day means classes in the morning and the library in the afternoon.
explanation: 说明专业并给出喜欢/不喜欢的原因。

title: Part 1 · 食物 Food
prompts: Is food in your country healthy?
sampleAnswer: I'm fond of spicy Sichuan dishes. I enjoy cooking on weekends as a way to relax. Traditional food at home is fairly balanced, though fast food is popular among young people.
explanation: Part 1 日常话题，回答自然流畅即可。

title: Part 1 · 天气 Weather
prompts: What is the weather like in your city?
Which season do you like best?
Does the weather affect your mood?
sampleAnswer: My city has four clear seasons. I prefer autumn because it's cool and sunny. Rainy days do make me a bit lazy, but I enjoy the fresh air after rain.
explanation: 给出偏好并简单解释原因。

title: Part 1 · 音乐 Music
prompts: What kind of music do you listen to?
sampleAnswer: I listen to pop and light jazz. They help me concentrate when studying. I tried learning the guitar but gave up after a few months—it was harder than I expected.
explanation: 举例说明，并可适当幽默。

title: Part 1 · 运动 Sport
prompts: Did you like sport at school?
Which sport do you want to try?
sampleAnswer: I play badminton with friends twice a week. At school I was never athletic, but now I find it a great stress reliever. I'd love to try surfing one day.
explanation: 说明频率与感受。

title: Part 1 · 电影 Films
prompts: Do you prefer cinema or home?
sampleAnswer: I watch a film most weekends. I like comedies and sci-fi. I prefer the cinema for the big screen, but streaming at home is more convenient.
explanation: 说明偏好并对比两种方式。

title: Part 1 · 阅读 Books
prompts: Did you read more as a child?
sampleAnswer: I read novels and the occasional biography. As a child I read far more, especially adventure stories. Now I read less because of my phone, if I'm honest.
explanation: 可诚实对比过去与现在。

title: Part 1 · 科技 Technology
prompts: Do you think we rely on tech too much?
sampleAnswer: I use a laptop, a phone and a smartwatch daily. Sometimes I feel we depend on screens too much. AI assistants interest me most—they're getting surprisingly useful.
explanation: 给出平衡看法。

title: Part 1 · 旅行 Travel
prompts: Do you prefer nature or cities?
sampleAnswer: I love travelling when I have time. Last spring I visited Guilin and loved the karst hills. I'm more into nature than busy cities—it helps me recharge.
explanation: 结合具体经历作答。

title: Part 1 · 健康 Health
prompts: Do you eat fruit and vegetables?
sampleAnswer: I try to sleep seven hours and eat salad a few times a week. I'm not perfect, but I avoid sugary drinks. Sleep matters most—I'm useless without it.
explanation: 具体习惯 + 个人感受。

title: Part 2 · 描述一本书
cueCard:
Describe a book that influenced you. You should say:
- what the book is and who wrote it
- when you read it
- what it is about
- and explain why it influenced you.
prompts: 可用 4W1E 结构：What / Who / When / Why
准备 1 分钟笔记，说满 2 分钟
加入个人感受与具体细节
sampleAnswer: I'd like to talk about 'Sapiens' by Yuval Noah Harari, which I read two years ago. It traces the history of humankind, and what struck me was how beliefs shape societies. It changed the way I see the modern world and inspired me to read more non-fiction.
explanation: Part 2 需说满 2 分钟，结构清晰、细节具体是关键。

title: Part 2 · 描述一次旅行
cueCard:
Describe a memorable trip you took. You should say:
- where you went
- who you went with
- what you did there
- and explain why it was memorable.
prompts: 按时间或地点顺序展开
突出一个 memorable 的瞬间
sampleAnswer: Last summer I visited Guilin with my cousin. We took a boat on the Li River and cycled through rice fields. The most memorable moment was watching the sunrise from a hill—it was breathtaking and made me forget all stress.
explanation: Part 2 需有清晰叙事与一个亮点细节。

title: Part 2 · 描述一位朋友
cueCard:
Describe a friend who is important to you. You should say:
- how you met
- what you do together
- what his/her personality is like
- and explain why the friendship matters.
sampleAnswer: I met Lily at university on the first day. We study together and hike on weekends. She's calm and honest, which balances my anxiety. Our friendship matters because she makes me feel supported no matter what.
explanation: 用细节让人物立体。

title: Part 2 · 描述一栋建筑
cueCard:
Describe a building you like. You should say:
- where it is
- what it is used for
- what it looks like
- and explain why you like it.
sampleAnswer: I love the old library in my town centre. It's a stone building with tall windows and a quiet reading hall. I like it because it feels timeless and peaceful—a perfect escape from noise.
explanation: 描述 + 情感理由。

title: Part 2 · 描述一项技能
cueCard:
Describe a skill you learned recently. You should say:
- what the skill is
- how you learned it
- how long it took
- and explain why it is useful.
sampleAnswer: I recently learned to cook simple pasta dishes from online videos. It took about a month to feel confident. It's useful because I save money and eat healthier than ordering takeaway.
explanation: 过程 + 收益。

title: Part 2 · 描述一个 App
cueCard:
Describe an app you often use. You should say:
- what it is
- when you started using it
- what you use it for
- and explain why you find it helpful.
sampleAnswer: I use a note-taking app called Notion every day. I started two years ago for university notes. It helps me organise tasks and sync across devices, which keeps my life in order.
explanation: 功能 + 个人收益。

title: Part 2 · 描述一顿饭
cueCard:
Describe a meal you enjoyed. You should say:
- where you had it
- who you were with
- what you ate
- and explain why you enjoyed it.
sampleAnswer: I enjoyed a hotpot dinner with friends last winter. We ordered many dishes and laughed for hours. I loved it because the warmth and company made a cold night feel special.
explanation: 氛围 + 情感。

title: Part 2 · 描述一位老师
cueCard:
Describe a teacher who influenced you. You should say:
- what subject they taught
- how they taught
- what made them special
- and explain their influence on you.
sampleAnswer: My high-school English teacher Mr. Wang influenced me most. He used real debates, not just textbooks, and encouraged mistakes. He built my confidence to speak, which helps me even now.
explanation: 风格 + 影响。

title: Part 2 · 描述一张照片
cueCard:
Describe a photo you like. You should say:
- when it was taken
- who is in it
- what is happening
- and explain why you like it.
sampleAnswer: There's a photo of my family at the beach five years ago. We're laughing with the sunset behind us. I like it because it captures a rare, happy moment we were all together.
explanation: 画面 + 记忆。

title: Part 2 · 描述一个决定
cueCard:
Describe an important decision you made. You should say:
- what the decision was
- how you made it
- what the result was
- and explain why it was important.
sampleAnswer: I decided to study abroad last year. I weighed career benefits against leaving family, then chose to go. It was important because it pushed me out of my comfort zone and boosted my independence.
explanation: 过程 + 成长意义。

title: Part 3 · 阅读习惯
prompts: Why do some people dislike reading?
How has the internet changed reading habits?
sampleAnswer: Some find reading dull because screens offer faster rewards. The internet has shortened attention spans but also made information free. Schools should foster reading by offering choice rather than only textbooks.
explanation: Part 3 考察抽象讨论与逻辑，需给出观点+理由+例子。

title: Part 3 · 旅游与环保
prompts: How can tourism be more sustainable?
Will people travel less in the future?
sampleAnswer: Tourism boosts local income but can strain resources. Sustainable travel means fewer flights and supporting local businesses. Despite remote work, I believe the desire to explore will keep travel alive.
explanation: Part 3 需分析利弊并提出看法。

title: Part 3 · 科技与教育
prompts: What are the risks for children?
sampleAnswer: Technology has widened access to knowledge through videos and courses. The risk is distraction and less face-to-face contact. Classrooms won't vanish, but they will blend with online tools.
explanation: Part 3 需平衡分析。

title: Part 3 · 饮食文化
sampleAnswer: Food cultures differ because of climate, history and religion. Fast food is convenient but harms health if eaten daily. Traditional food deserves protection as part of a community's identity.
explanation: Part 3 需结合文化视角。
